d: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke addressed a media briefing alongside co-convener Ashutosh Ranka to announce a 'Save Democracy, Save Constitution' public rally in Nagpur. Dipke alleged systemic election rigging and voter disenfranchisement, stating that electoral outcomes are being decided centrally rather than through genuine democratic processes. Emphasising adherence to constitutional values, he asserted, "Ye desh chalega to sirf aur sirf Baba Saheb Ambedkar ke likhe hue samvidhan se."
